entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A ghost-phasing planeswalker and assassin who carries the Sword of the Realms to Halvar and kills Varragoth.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: An elf prince and young planeswalker who stops his brother's army from fighting the humans and decides to explore the Multiverse.

entities.name: Arni Brokenbrow
entities.description: The grinning leader of the Tuskeri who holds off draugr so Kaya and Tyvar can reach the bridge.

entities.name: Fynn the Fangbearer
entities.description: The older, snow-haired leader of the Kannah who distrusts elves.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: The leader of the Omenseekers who brings Kaya and Tyvar to the clan council.

entities.name: Sigrid, God-Favored
entities.description: The leader of the Beskir whose fortress hosts the war council.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: An old god of Kaldheim with a raven named Hakka who reveals that Halvar can wield the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Halvar
entities.description: The god of battle for whom the Sword of the Realms was meant, who holds a bridge alone and then uses the sword to seal the rifts.

entities.name: Cosima
entities.description: The sea goddess who leaps from the river in dolphin form and fights beside Kaya.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: A winged demon jarl with an iron axe, long imprisoned, who attacks the ravens and Kaya's group and is killed by Kaya.

entities.name: Harald
aliases: King of the elves of Skemfar
entities.description: Tyvar's older brother, king of the elves of Skemfar and uniter of the tribes of Wood and Shadow, who leads an army to the battle.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A stranger who arrives with the Valkyries, throws shards of solid mirror, and asks Kaya about Theros.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: A continent-sized serpent that tears open a rift in the sky and then dives into the rift to Karfell.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: The goddess who brews the potion of divinity from the sap of the World Tree and is mortally wounded by a monster in her sanctum.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A creature with a stitched-together voice who attacks Esika, steals a sap sample from the World Tree's well, and returns through a red portal.

entities.name: Sword of the Realms
entities.description: A Tyrite-forged, glass-like sword with swirling blues and greens, made for Halvar by Koll, which can separate the realms.

entities.name: Koll
entities.description: The smith who finished the Sword of the Realms and died, taking the secret of wielding it to the grave.

entities.name: Toralf
entities.description: A warrior god named alongside Halvar.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Planeswalker whose treachery set off the Doomskar and a lie that sent the elves to war.

entities.name: Hakka
entities.description: The raven who rides on Alrund's shoulder.

entities.name: Draugr
entities.description: An undead army from Karfell pouring through a rift into Bretagard, including undead Torga trolls.

entities.name: Demons
entities.description: Winged demons led by Varragoth who attack the clans and are driven off.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Winged arbiters of judgement who pour from Koma's rift to fight the demons.

entities.name: Elves of Skemfar
entities.description: Brass-armored army led by Harald that comes to join the battle.

entities.name: Tuskeri
entities.description: A clan of braveswords of the Tusk mountains led by Arni.

entities.name: Kannah
entities.description: A clan of the Aldergard led by Fynn.

entities.name: Beskir
entities.description: The clan led by Sigrid whose stronghold hosts the council.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: A crew led by Inga Rune-Eyes.

entities.name: Skelle
entities.description: Raiders gathering in their marshes and swearing blood oaths for war.

entities.name: Torga trolls
entities.description: Giant mossy trolls, some of them animated as undead by the rift, one of which is swept away by Cosima.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: The human realm of Kaldheim where the battle is fought.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: The frozen realm of the dead from which the draugr come.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: The elf realm ruled by Harald.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The heroic realm where souls feast and fight.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The great tree whose sap Esika brews into the potion of divinity.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: The catastrophe of rifts between realms, ended by Halvar with the Sword of the Realms.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane Niko asks Kaya about.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of the realms and the World Tree.

events.summary: A raven flies over Bretagard, seeing fire giants, gathering Skelle, and a great fleet, to the Beskir Stronghold.
events.quote: the greatest fleet of the age riding the wind westward

events.summary: Arni and Fynn arrive at the Beskir Stronghold, where Inga Rune-Eyes and Sigrid await with strangers Tyvar and Kaya.
events.quote: Inga Rune-Eyes, leader of the Omenseekers, had already arrived, and this fortress belonged to Sigrid, God-Favored.

events.summary: Fynn refuses to accept an elf prince as a friend, and Sigrid reminds him she called him to plan survival.
events.quote: I didn't invite you into my hold to insult my guests, Fynn.

events.summary: Sigrid lists the threats of trolls, demons, giants and the draugr of the Dread Marn.
events.quote: which means the Dread Marn, Karfell's dead army, has returned

events.summary: Kaya lays the Sword of the Realms on the table, and they learn Koll finished it but died with the secret of wielding it.
events.quote: But he took the secrets of how to wield it to the grave.

events.summary: Alrund steps from the shadows and says only Halvar, God of Battle, can wield the sword.
events.quote: The god for whom the sword was meant. Halvar, God of Battle.

events.summary: The leaders and Kaya's group ride giant ravens through the sky toward Halvar.
events.quote: the giant ravens that now carried them through the sky

events.summary: From the air they see a rift to Karfell spilling draugr and undead trolls toward a bridge.
events.quote: from the edge of the opening thin, rotting figures dragged themselves hand over hand into the human realm

events.summary: They see Halvar alone on the bridge before a heap of destroyed draugr.
events.quote: Before him, on the near side of the bridge, was a mound of destroyed draugr nearly waist-high.

events.summary: Varragoth strikes the ravens and knocks Kaya, Tyvar and Arni into the air.
events.quote: a crunching sound, an avian shriek, and suddenly Kaya was knocked from her perch and into open air

events.summary: Kaya catches Arni and Tyvar in the fall and phases all three through the river.
events.quote: one more to turn all three of them insubstantial

events.summary: They climb out among the draugr and fight, and Arni stays behind to hold the horde while the others go on.
events.quote: You two go on ahead. I'll keep this lot busy.

events.summary: The elves of Skemfar march into view, and Tyvar leaves to stop his brother's army.
events.quote: the elves of Skemfar, marching to war

events.summary: Cosima leaps from the river as a dolphin and sweeps a wall of water over an undead troll and draugr.
events.quote: It swept over the undead Torga and a handful of draugr.

events.summary: Cosima joins Kaya to reach Halvar, sent by Alrund.
events.quote: Alrund did not send me to visit.

events.summary: Varragoth lands on the ground between them and the bridge.
events.quote: He beat his wings once, then settled on the ground.

events.summary: Kaya and Cosima fight Varragoth; Kaya's axes wound him but he is barely slowed.
events.quote: The second axe, this one in Kaya's hand, drove into his knee.

events.summary: Harald's elves arrive and form a pike wall against the demons.
events.quote: A line of pike-bearers set their hafts against the ground, forming a wall between Kaya and the demons.

events.summary: Tyvar introduces Kaya to his brother, King Harald.
events.quote: Harald, King of the elves of Skemfar, uniter of the tribes of Wood and Shadow.

events.summary: Tyvar thickens the elves' armor as demons press the line.
events.quote: He put his hands on the backs of their armor

events.summary: Harald says Tyvar prevented him from making a mistake.
events.quote: He prevented me from making a mistake, here.

events.summary: Harald carries Kaya on his reindeer through the battle to the bridge.
events.quote: He pulled her onto the reindeer.

events.summary: Kaya tosses the Sword of the Realms to Halvar, who says he can use it to separate the realms if given time.
events.quote: Kaya tossed him the sword, which turned end over end through the air

events.summary: Halvar asks them to hold the bridge while he sits and channels the sword.
events.quote: Hold the bridge until I can separate the realms once more.

events.summary: A new rift opens in the sky and Koma, the Cosmos Serpent, emerges.
events.quote: Koma. The Cosmos Serpent.

events.summary: Koma dives into the Karfell rift, and Valkyries pour out of its own rift to attack the demons.
events.quote: They slammed into the demons from above, feathered wings tangling with leather membrane

events.summary: Kaya meets the Valkyries' companion Niko Aris after saving them from a draugr.
events.quote: Niko. Niko Aris.

events.summary: Varragoth, wounded with Tyvar clinging to his back, is bound by Harald's snakes and tears free.
events.quote: They wrapped round Varragoth's legs, binding him

events.summary: Kaya kills Varragoth by cutting his throat with an axe while he is distracted by Tyvar.
events.quote: swung an axe clean through his throat

events.summary: Halvar's sword light sweeps over the rift and it closes, ending the flow of draugr.
events.quote: Slowly, like a healing wound, the rift began to shrink and close.

events.summary: Demons flee and Halvar seals the holes in the world as a child watches from the village.
events.quote: as the god of battle sealed up the holes in the world

events.summary: Tyvar tells Kaya he wants to see the Multiverse.
events.quote: I'd like to see what there is to see, out in your Multiverse.

events.summary: At the crossroads, the leaders review losses and the draugr and demons that escaped.
events.quote: We broke the draugr lines and drove off their main body

events.summary: Harald announces the elves will return to Skemfar.
events.quote: The elves will return to Skemfar, to care for our own

events.summary: Niko asks Kaya whether a plane called Theros exists.
events.quote: These planes. Is there one called Theros?

events.summary: In the World Tree's sanctum, a monster has mortally wounded the goddess Esika.
events.quote: Esika was dying.

events.summary: The monster tells Esika she lacks the hunger and fear to survive and drops her.
events.quote: Not enough hunger in you. Not enough fear to survive. Soon, though.

events.summary: The monster takes a sample of the World Tree's sap and prepares to return.
events.quote: I am ready to return.

events.summary: A red portal opens and a voice welcomes Vorinclex back.
events.quote: We step ever closer to perfection.

relations.quote: swung an axe clean through his throat

relations.note: Kaya and Tyvar fight together and she credits him with saving her.
relations.quote: But he saved me. More than once.

relations.note: Cosima fights at Kaya's side to reach Halvar.
Harald is king of the elves of Skemfar.
relations.quote: Harald, King of the elves of Skemfar, uniter of the tribes of Wood and Shadow.
Inga Rune-Eyes, leader of the Omenseekers

relations.note: Fynn distrusts elves and their prince.
Koll forged the sword before dying.
relations.quote: Koll must have finally finished the bloody thing

relations.note: The monster attacks Esika in her sanctum.
relations.quote: if the monster who had done this was not holding her up with one raw, flesh-colored claw
